results.1-1: Acquire (obtain or steal) an important item or items.
results.2-2: Capture one or more of the opponents.
results.4-4: Frame a character or tarnish their reputation.
results.5-5: Drive the opponent into a corner or ambush point.
results.6-6: Stop a magical ritual, legal ceremony, or time-sensitive spell.
results.7-7: Hold the line—keep the enemy from reaching a specific area or group.
results.8-8: Plant evidence or a tracking device on a target.
results.9-9: Secure a specific location ahead of another group’s arrival.
results.10-10: Harass the opponent to deplete their resources or keep them occupied.
results.11-11: Destroy a piece of architecture, a statue, a shrine, or a weapon.
results.12-12: Investigate a situation to confirm or deny existing information.
